findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation is disabled (AWS defaults it to false). This key protects the audit bucket, so a compromised or leaked key material remains valid indefinitely, and key rotation is a required control for long-lived encryption keys under most compliance frameworks.
